title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: users can upload local and OneDrive files to custom engine agents
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, control paths and command are supported, and searches confirm the narrowly stated documentation gaps. The general billing and metered-agent default statements need qualifications from Microsoft's newer licensing guidance.

claims.claim: The Agents admin guide says agents accessing shared tenant data such as SharePoint or Graph Connector content are billed on metered consumption.
claims.quote: Agents that access shared tenant data, such as SharePoint or Graph Connector content, are billed based on metered consumption.
claims.fix: The guide's search excerpt supports this statement, but newer guidance qualifies it. Replace it with: 'For Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 (Basic) licences, agents accessing shared tenant data are billed on metered consumption. The Copilot Studio licensing page says classic answers, generative answers and Microsoft Graph tenant grounding are not charged for Microsoft 365 Copilot licence holders when the agent runs with their authenticated identity in Copilot Chat, Teams or SharePoint.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/manage-agents-copilot-chat and the already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/billing-licensing. In the cost rationale, qualify 'agents that access shared tenant data' with 'for Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 (Basic) licences'.

claims.claim: The Agents admin guide says agents using metered consumption are off by default for users in Microsoft Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Agents utilizing metered consumption are off by default for users in Microsoft Copilot Chat.
claims.fix: The cited guide excerpt supports the statement, but the newer purchase guide distinguishes licences. Replace it with: 'Pay-as-you-go agents are off by default for Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) users; the purchase guide says no action is needed to enable agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium).' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/manage-agents-copilot-chat.
